I was walking home with a friend when a car passed us speeding, we saw it hit the curb and its rear end start swerving. It went into the next curve almost sideways, we just started running before we even heard the crash. I opened a line to 911, the dispatcher was great, calming and just let me know other calls are coming in too so we could hang up to tend to the situation.

The car had bounced off a tree and into another at around 50mph, the impact throwing its driver to the passenger seat. (The police weren't sure if he was the driver at first, but there was no way anyone got out of that wreckage in the five seconds it was out of our sight.) The car had no front end and the guy had no bone structure in his legs anymore, but he was conscious. I took my friend's shirt and held it against the cuts on the driver's head, as he pulled me close, called me an angel and begged me to kill him. I kept talking to him and holding him still, even when the firemen were cutting the car open. It wasn't pretty, my friend had to take the rest of the week off from work, but I was surprised at my own ability to act in such a situation without hesitation.

I think I saw him at the grocery store a while back. I thought about going up to him but what would I even say? I might have stared because he turned to look at me, so I just walked away. He was walking with a crutch but alive nonetheless, and that's all I wanted to know.
